edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.mechanism: EPA and DHA lower hepatic VLDL production, shift membrane lipid signaling, and can modestly dampen inflammatory eicosanoid tone. Those mechanisms matter most for LDL cholesterol when baseline triglycerides are high or the outcome is tightly linked to cardiometabolic inflammation.
edges.summary: In general adult, pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest that omega-3 in adults with normal triglycerides tracks with mixed effects on ldl cholesterol. Most disagreement in the literature is about size, subgroup sensitivity, or dose threshold rather than about whether the relationship exists at all.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
